scope: Native immutable suggestion capture, historical intent proof, typed read dependencies and exact-owner pure previews. Rust-only functionality; no suggestion Accept/Reject or transport is exposed. Full advanced-review goal remains active.

verification.strictNativeLibraryAndFocusedContractCli: passed; existing vendor unused-import warning retained
verification.strictRelayAllTargetServerClippy: passed; existing vendor unused-import warning retained

contracts: Separate closed breditor/document-suggestion V1 family. Source anchor, native edit, descriptive attribution and content address; no accepted AST, credential, live permission or decision.
Explicit Commands versus Document scope. Command batches and one general rich-range edit have separate typed variants; no JavaScript lowering or plain-text fallback.
Capture and previews are pure even for a read-only document owner. Accepted content, local UI, native counters and all history/checkpoint bytes remain unchanged.
Descriptive read admission is weaker than native source proof. Missing native history remains pending; a valid digest does not excuse bad coordinates, wrong bindings or source scope.

Native-derived source dependencies exhaustively cover every existing command variant. Independent image fields and table-axis/body changes can remain disjoint; caption replacement guards the old caption.
Affected subtrees also retain native character identity witnesses; equal-looking replacement characters do not become original targets.
Ready previews retain a live exact-owner publication witness. A changed publication needs a new preview, even when its original proposal dependencies still match. No preview authorizes acceptance.

reproducedRepairs.location: suggestions/read_set.rs checked semantic equality without original scalar identity.
reproducedRepairs.repair: Derive native scalar cursor identity witnesses from retained source history and compare them against current affected subtrees.
reproducedRepairs.evidence: The equal_looking_replacement_characters regression failed before the witness and passes with explicit Conflict afterward.

bounds.generalRichRange: Uses the existing bounded native semantic planner, rich-run/floor constraints and protected-structure preservation rather than expanded command count.

remaining: Granular character-affine rebasing and proposal revision/conflict resolution. Current text intents conservatively conflict if any affected source text block changes, even for a disjoint edit within that block.
Authenticated durable proposal/decision ledger and exact offline proposal/decision recovery. Accept/Reject must finalize once in server order with atomic accepted native effects.
Ordinary selective Undo ownership for accepted foreign effects, without reserving/fencing the user's ordinary offline document writer.
Paired Wasm/SDK, vanilla/React suggestion controls and clean-installed combined review/document acceptance.
Final V1, public-host, storage lifecycle, performance and broad physical browser/IME/accessibility qualification. This checkpoint does not claim a repair of the separate historical WebKit fault.
